manual_title: Vireo BPM-250 Blister Packing Machine: Operation and Maintenance Manual (synthetic)

sections.title: 1.3 Lockout and hot surfaces
sections.text: 1. Stop the machine with the STOP key at the end of a cycle. 2. Switch the main switch S0 to OFF and lock it with your personal padlock; attach a danger tag. 3. Close the compressed air ball valve and open the dump valve DV1 until the air gauge reads 0 bar. 4. Forming and sealing plates run at up to 160 °C. Wait until the plate temperature on the display is below 50 °C before touching them, or wear heat-resistant gloves. 5. Check for zero energy: press START; the machine must not move.

sections.title: 2.1 Machine overview
sections.text: PVC film runs from the unwind reel over the dancer arm to the forming station, where the upper and lower heating plates soften the film and compressed air forms the pockets in the forming die. Tablets are fed into the pockets, then aluminium lidding foil is sealed on at the sealing station by the heated sealing plate. The strip is embossed with the batch code, perforated and punched into blister cards. Each heating plate has heater cartridges and a type K thermocouple connected to a temperature controller with a solid-state relay.

sections.title: 5.2 E-31 Forming heater temperature low
sections.text: Symptom: alarm E-31, forming plate temperature more than 10 °C below the set point; pockets come out shallow or uneven and the machine stops. Likely causes: a failed heater cartridge, a loose or failed thermocouple, a failed solid-state relay. Procedure: 1. Lock out the machine and let the plates cool (section 1.3). 2. Disconnect the heater cartridges at the terminal box and measure each one: a good cartridge reads 40 to 50 ohm; open circuit means failed. Replace a failed cartridge with BPM-HC-250 (250 W, 230 V). 3. Check that the thermocouple sits fully in its bore and the clamp is tight. Refit it with heat-transfer paste BPM-HP-02; replace a damaged thermocouple with BPM-TC-K2. 4. If cartridges and thermocouple are good, ask the electrician to check solid-state relay BPM-SSR-40. 5. Heat up for 20 minutes and check pocket depth on 10 strips. Typical time: 60 minutes.

sections.title: 5.3 E-44 Sealing temperature deviation
sections.text: Symptom: alarm E-44, sealing plate temperature outside set point plus or minus 5 °C; risk of leaking blisters. The machine stops. Likely causes: failed sealing heater cartridge, thermocouple not in contact, display showing the controller set point instead of the actual temperature. Procedure: 1. Lock out and cool down (section 1.3). 2. Measure the sealing heater cartridges (40 to 50 ohm). Replace failed ones with BPM-HC-250. 3. Reseat the thermocouple with heat-transfer paste BPM-HP-02. 4. After heat-up, check the plate surface temperature with a calibrated contact thermometer; it must be within 5 °C of the set point. 5. Run a blue dye leak test on 20 blisters from each lane before restarting the batch. Typical time: 60 minutes.

sections.title: 5.4 E-52 Film web break
sections.text: Symptom: alarm E-52, the PVC web is broken or the film reel has run out; the machine stops. Likely causes: a bad splice, too high web tension, a worn or seized guide roller, film stuck to a hot forming plate. Procedure: 1. Lock out the machine (section 1.3). 2. Remove the broken film from the forming station. 3. Rethread the film along the path shown in the figure, under the dancer arm. 4. Check every guide roller turns freely; replace a seized roller with BPM-GR-08. 5. Join the film with splice tape, keeping the splice straight. 6. Run 5 empty cycles at low speed and check the web runs centred. Typical time: 20 minutes.

sections.title: 5.5 W-12 Film tracking deviation
sections.text: Warning W-12 appears when the film edge sensor sees the web more than 2 mm off centre. The machine keeps running. First actions: check the film reel is pushed fully onto the unwind shaft and the reel core is not damaged; clean the edge sensor; adjust the web guide by turning the tracking knob a quarter turn at a time. Repeated W-12 warnings often come before an E-52 web break.

sections.title: 5.6 E-60 Punching die jam
sections.text: Symptom: alarm E-60, cut blister cards stuck in the punching die; the machine stops. Likely causes: a blunt punching die, misaligned perforation, foil build-up. Procedure: 1. Lock out (section 1.3). 2. Remove the stuck cards and foil pieces with plastic tweezers. 3. Inspect the punch and die edges; a blunt or chipped die set must be replaced with BPM-PD-01 by maintenance. 4. Check card position against the punch with one slow cycle. Typical time: 35 minutes.

sections.title: 5.7 W-27 Compressed air pressure low
sections.text: Warning W-27 appears when the supply air pressure is below 5.5 bar. Pocket forming needs at least 5.5 bar. First actions: check the plant air supply and the machine filter regulator; drain water from the filter bowl; look and listen for leaks at the forming station. If pressure falls below 5 bar the machine stops.

sections.title: 7.1 Return to service after a repair
sections.text: 1. Remove tools, close guards, remove your lock and tag. 2. Heat up for 20 minutes. 3. Run empty strips and check pocket shape, seal pattern and batch code. 4. Do a blue dye leak test on 20 blisters from each lane; all must pass before tablets are fed. 5. QA checks the first cards before the batch continues. 6. Do line clearance as per the plant SOP and record the repair in the equipment logbook.

error_codes.title: Forming heater temperature low
first_actions: Lock out and let the plates cool below 50 °C
Measure each heater cartridge: 40 to 50 ohm is good
Check the thermocouple is fully in its bore

error_codes.title: Sealing temperature deviation
first_actions: Run a dye leak test on 20 blisters per lane before restarting

error_codes.title: Film web break
first_actions: Rethread the film under the dancer arm
Check every guide roller turns freely

error_codes.title: Punching die jam
first_actions: Remove stuck cards with plastic tweezers

error_codes.title: Guard open
likely_causes: A guard door is open or its interlock is misaligned
first_actions: Close all guards; never bypass an interlock

error_codes.title: Film tracking deviation
likely_causes: Reel not fully on the shaft
first_actions: Push the reel fully onto the shaft
Adjust the tracking knob a quarter turn at a time

error_codes.title: Compressed air pressure low
likely_causes: Air leak at the forming station
first_actions: Check plant air and the filter regulator
